name: Traveling Merchants
description: A dedicated merchant NPC that appears OUT ON THE ROUTES (not towns), travels route-to-route by in-game day (via world_clock), and patrols under real collision read from the engine (mapOverview). Spawned/removed at runtime via the world API - no map edits, no NPC hijacking. Selectable route mode (3/5/random-daily) in OPTIONS; daily-rotating supplies shop. Rare wares, fossils, and Pokemon come next.
